other_conditions: Must be a resident of Odisha.
Must be between 18 and 60 years old.
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
Must be a nominee of a deceased registered member of the Board.
The deceased member must have died due to natural or accidental causes.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹1,00,000 for natural death and ₹2,00,000 for accidental death to the nominee of a deceased registered worker.
